contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence, and responding directly to ops: ops anchors its 'rollback path is proven' claim on artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3, but that artifact does not exist in the evidence list — the actual artifact:ops-runbook explicitly states no rollback rehearsal has been run for the rebuild job. Combined with artifact:incident-log (two sev2 retry storms last quarter) and the fact that neither artifact:test-report nor artifact:perf-report exercised the rebuild under retry-storm failure conditions, the reliability case still lacks targeted evidence; the apparent cross-role consensus rests partly on a phantom artifact, which reinforces rather than resolves the evidence gap.
